name: Mohamed Baltagy
detail: His April 2026 proposal is described by one report as a wealth tax, but his own explanation describes a fixed compulsory contribution from affluent people rather than a levy measured on wealth or net worth.

name: Hany Qadry Demian
detail: The directly located Finance Ministry policy was a temporary 5% additional tax on high annual income, not a tax on wealth or net worth. A later report's reference to a 'wealth tax' did not supply a primary wealth-tax proposal.
